population_note_text: Books population (optional, cancelled and post-dated vouchers excluded); Contra excluded throughout. A loan ledger's interest journals are vouchers whose only other ledger lines are its configured interest ledger or ledgers (the client's list of loans) and any ledger the client configures as TDS payable; every other voucher touching the loan ledger is a taken (credit) or repaid (debit) transaction, never classified by ledger name -- except one that both credits and debits the loan ledger, which is listed as the books hold it, not divided into entries.

figures.definition_text: The credit sides of the vouchers listed as both crediting and debiting loan ledger (tag b13d15a1), summed: in the loan's credits before any filter, in no reportable total.
The debit sides of the vouchers listed as both crediting and debiting loan ledger (tag b13d15a1), summed: in the loan's debits before any filter, in no reportable total.

Sum of the repayments that Clause 31(c) reports: entries on a loan from a lender outside the form's reporting exemption, where the balance being repaid, with or without the interest credited and not yet paid, or the repayment itself reaches the s.269SS/269T limit. A voucher listed as both crediting and debiting one loan is in neither total, even where one side reaches the limit; from its date on, an entry on that loan is in it only if its own amount reaches the limit.

Debits to loan ledger (tag b13d15a1) other than its interest journals -- amount repaid in the year, before any Clause 31/s.269T lender-exemption or mode filter. It includes the debit side of each voucher listed as both crediting and debiting the loan.

Sum of the loans taken that Clause 31(a) reports: entries on a loan from a lender outside the form's reporting exemption, from where the running balance with that lender reaches the s.269SS/269T limit, or whose own amount does. A voucher listed as both crediting and debiting one loan is in neither total, even where one side reaches the limit; from its date on, an entry on that loan is in it only if its own amount reaches the limit.

Credits to loan ledger (tag b13d15a1) other than its interest journals -- amount taken/accepted in the year, before any Clause 31/s.269SS lender-exemption or mode filter. It includes the credit side of each voucher listed as both crediting and debiting the loan.

Vouchers listed as both crediting and debiting a loan ledger, counted once per loan ledger they are listed on, as the books hold them: not divided into entries, in no reportable total and not in the flag count (#779).

Whether the assessee must deduct TDS under s.194A for the year -- the same rule and figure as 'TDS on payments made': firm/LLP/company always; individual/HUF only if previous-year business turnover exceeded the rules' turnover limit for an individual or HUF.

The configured interest ledger name(s) for loan ledger (tag b13d15a1), one per line, or '' if the loan is interest-free -- this test's own consistency checks read them back to check each voucher on this loan and its interest ledger(s) independently of the test's own bucketing.

The lines on loan ledger (tag b13d15a1)'s interest ledger(s) in the vouchers listed as both crediting and debiting the loan, summed (debits positive): shown beside the interest total, never added to it.

Interest paid/credited on loan ledger (tag b13d15a1): sum of every voucher whose only other lines are its configured interest ledger(s) and any ledger in the client's statutory dues classified as TDS payable, counted before that TDS.
Lender type for loan ledger (tag b13d15a1) from the client's list of loans, classified by the loan ledger this interest pairs with -- never by a word in the ledger name.
Ledgers under Loans (Liability), other than bank and cash ledgers, that moved in the year and are not in the client's list of loans (each has a notice).

Ledgers that moved in the year, are not in the client's list of loans and are not bank or cash ledgers, whose Tally group chain is incomplete: whether each is under Loans (Liability) cannot be told, so neither notice is raised for it.

Ledgers under Current Liabilities, Sundry Creditors or Suspense A/c, not in the client's list of loans, with bank debits of one amount in 3 or more months narrated with ACH, NACH, ECS or EMI (each has a notice).

figures.value: not computed: a voucher both credits and debits this loan ledger, and this test does not divide it into entries, so the balance from its date on is not known
figures.definition_text: The running maximum of the outstanding balance on loan ledger (tag b13d15a1) -- the utility's MaxAmtOsAccPy column -- is not computed on a loan with a voucher listed as both crediting and debiting it (#779).

Whether the TDS on loan ledger (tag b13d15a1) covers the s.194A rate on its interest: covered, partly covered, covered by amount but not by date (the TDS seen reaches the rate, while the date-aware count, reversals included, credits less), none, not judged where the rules carry no s.194A rate, or not computed where a voucher listed as both crediting and debiting the loan carries interest or TDS and TDS is seen on the loan. The rate assumes the lender furnished a PAN: s.206AA's higher rate is not applied, and the books do not show a PAN.

Loan ledgers with a non-exempt lender whose interest this year exceeds the s.194A threshold, where the assessee is a deductor or its deductor status is not known, and the TDS seen does not cover the s.194A rate on it (each listed in clause 21(b)); a loan whose s.194A verdict is not computed is not counted.
Reportable taken/repaid rows in cash/journal/other mode at or over the s.269SS/269T limit (₹20,000). 1 voucher(s) listed as both crediting and debiting a loan are not counted.

Entries and vouchers whose s.269SS/269T flag is not computed and may apply: rows the two walks of the balance disagree on, which the second would flag; loans taken that may cross the limit if earlier repayments paid interest first (bridge#802); entries in cash, journal or other mode dated on or after a voucher listed as both crediting and debiting their loan; and such vouchers whose other lines include a ledger that is not a bank account. Listed as questions or noted on the row, never in the flag count.
TDS deducted on loan ledger (tag b13d15a1): the lines on ledgers in the client's statutory dues classified as TDS payable, on every voucher that posts to the loan.

The ledgers the client's statutory dues classify as TDS payable, less every loan's interest ledger and every shared one, one per line: the TDS lines this test reads. Its own consistency checks read them back.
This voucher's (tag df8539e2) credits on ledgers other than loan ledger (tag b13d15a1) read as bank (from the ledger's group or the client's configuration), summed.
At least this much of this voucher's (tag df8539e2) credit to loan ledger (tag b13d15a1) is set off against its debit to the loan: the voucher's other debit lines total less than that credit.
The credit lines on loan ledger (tag b13d15a1) in this voucher (tag df8539e2), summed: the voucher also debits the loan.
The debit lines on loan ledger (tag b13d15a1) in this voucher (tag df8539e2), summed: the voucher also credits the loan.
This voucher's (tag df8539e2) credits on ledgers other than loan ledger (tag b13d15a1) read as tds (from the ledger's group or the client's configuration), summed.

findings.title_text: Loan ledger both credited and debited in one voucher: listed as the books hold it, not divided into entries by this test (Invented Listed Lender) (possible s.269SS/269T)
limits_text: This voucher credits the loan ₹4,000 and debits it ₹10,000. This test does not yet divide a voucher with both sides on one loan into its entries, so it lists it as the books hold it: in no reportable total and not in the s.269SS/269T flag count. Both sides stay in the loan's credits and debits before any filter.
By the voucher's own arithmetic at least ₹4,000 of the credit is set off against the debit: its other debit lines total less than the credit.
Every entry on this loan dated on or after this voucher is tested on its own amount only: its reportability by the running balance is not computed, and neither is the loan's maximum balance.

Possible s.269T: the voucher's other credit lines include a ledger that is not a bank account (cash, a journal or another ledger). Whether a limit is breached is not computed; this is not in the s.269SS/269T flag count.
It was not compared with this loan's other entries for reversal pairs or repeated narrations.
ask_client_text: Entry by entry, what was taken from the lender, repaid to it, credited as interest or a charge, and withheld as TDS in this voucher, and by what mode (cash, bank, adjustment)? If part of it corrects another part, which?

module_invariant_violations.detail: LOAN-1: Loan Listed (tag b13d15a1) expected FY movement 700000p (= -taken 400000p + repaid 1000000p - interest 0p + TDS 100000p) does not tie the TB movement 600000p (opening -5000000p, closing -4400000p); difference 100000p -- a voucher on this loan ledger was likely dropped from or wrongly added to the population.
